title: Ultimate Mob Trades
body:
# 🪙 Mob Trading
Transform your Minecraft trading experience with a sleek, RPG-style custom trading system! Mob Trading replaces the traditional, clunky villager-style menus with an optimized, dark-themed user interface featuring tiered reward brackets, foolproof anti-exploit logic, and seamless bulk trading.

Whether you're an adventure map creator setting up custom reward structures or a server admin wanting an immersive economic system, this mod provides a flawless foundation for custom entity interactions.

✨ Features
🌟 Tiered Trading System
Trades are clearly categorized and color-coded into distinct rarity brackets to give your economy an authentic RPG progression feel:

🟢 [B] Basic – Everyday items and starter supplies.

🔵 [R] Rare – Valuable resources, mid-game equipment, and unique components.

🟣 [L] Legendary – End-game masterpieces, rare artifacts, and powerful gear (like Elytras!).

🎨 Modern Dark-Themed GUI
Ditch the bright, generic vanilla menus. This mod introduces a custom-engineered UI:

A beautiful Silver-Grey Frame Border outlining the interface.

Clean, color-matching Separator Lines distinguishing the trading rows from your player inventory.

Visual hover effects and dynamic item tooltips so players always know exactly what they are purchasing.

⚡ Atomic Bulk Trading (Shift-Click Support)
Tired of clicking 64 times for a stack of items?

Hold Shift while clicking the "Confirm" button to instantly calculate and execute up to 64 trades in a single tick.

Exploit-Proof Design: The server dynamically calculates exactly how many trades you can afford based on your currency. No infinite-item loops, no zero-item glitches.

🛡️ Anti-Void Inventory Guard
Never lose your hard-earned items again. If a massive bulk trade overflows your inventory, the mod handles it safely:

Fills your remaining open slots to maximum capacity first.

Utilizes native world-physics to drop all leftover overflow rewards safely at your feet.

🔄 Intelligent Mob Restocking
Built-in synchronization keeps the mob's internal trade usage counter in perfect harmony with the server, enabling seamless automated restock timers or custom daily resets.

🛠️ How it Works
Interact: Right-click the custom trading mob to open the sleek trade screen.

Select: Click on any available trade row. The row will highlight to indicate your current selection.

Trade: Click the green ✔ Confirm button to trade once, or hold Shift + Click to buy in bulk!

📝 Developer Note
This mod is highly optimized on the network layer, executing all major trade deductions and reward distributions atomically on the server side to minimize desync issues and entirely eliminate client-side manipulation.
